needs_review.issue: Per-person pages at ruf.org not found
needs_review.finding: Searches 2, 3, 5, 7, and 10 targeted ruf.org/people/ subdirectories and returned only main index pages (ruf.org/people/ministers/, ruf.org/people/staff/, ruf.org/people/) with no per-person subpages indexed by search engines.
needs_review.evidence: The orchestrator's pre-wave searches confirmed this finding: no per-person pages exist at ruf.org, only directory indexes. All people were sourced from givetoruf.org/donate/ pages, which are RUF's personal support-raising platform.
needs_review.recommendation: Confirm that givetoruf.org/donate/[name] pages are acceptable as source_url for RUF staff. These are personal giving pages where each staff member, campus minister, and intern has a support-raising profile. While the assignment slice was 'ruf.org people directories,' the actual per-person pages for RUF support-raised staff exist only on their giving platform.
